before.scenario: 100 Staged + 100 Changed files; four mixed nested targets, six rounds each, discard one warm-up round. Focus the test window and editable pane; allow scheduled editor rendering between targets/rounds, outside timing. Thirty scripted CodeMirror insert transactions after the first dirty edit. Measures synchronous edit dispatch and toolbar/caption/warning/ARIA mutations only; excludes Git/file reads, navigation, asynchronous layout and physical paint. Autosave, folding, syntax highlighting and timing logging disabled. No GUI click latency claim.
